content.intro: Learn pagination and large datasets through a compact visual, an inspectable Django example, and a practical verification task.
content.why_it_matters: Pagination and Large Datasets matters because a Django project has to behave predictably across requests, database state, configuration, and deployments. Understanding this piece makes the surrounding application easier to test, maintain, and secure.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: This lesson examines pagination and large datasets as part of performance, caching, and scalability. The objective is to understand the behavior, connect it to the listed subtopics, and verify it with a small example rather than relying on memorized syntax.

content_blocks.title: What to cover
content_blocks.text: The source syllabus for this lesson names: Database-side pagination; Efficient ordering; Avoiding large in-memory lists; Cursor-based approaches; Query performance under large datasets. Keep these distinct concepts together: know what each item does, when it applies, and what assumption must be verified in your project.
